latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of claude-code-openclaw.

- Orchestrates coding, refactoring, and review tasks via local Claude Code, integrating tightly with BMad agent workflows.
- Enforces disciplined execution paths: one-shot headless task, direct slash workflow, or official BMad agent persona—no ad hoc methods.
- BMad project operating system rules enforced for repos with `_bmad/` directory; inspects installed capability set before any execution.
- Provides robust guidance on prompt structure, token discipline, orchestration patterns, artifact-based completion, and escalation policy.
- Includes comprehensive reference list for operational troubleshooting, workflow integration, and prompt templates.
